WHY NO MORE THAN 2 SONGS? 
Pitching takes time and I prefer to spread that effort across multiple artists. If you pitch and place all your songs at once they rise & fall together. Instead I recommend focusing on a few songs at a time to extend their presence and increase their visibility over a longer period.
The playlists are neither editorial nor algorithmic & may take time for Spotify to report as they are individually curated. I take your music seriously & avoid placing it on botted playlists.
Some playlists perform better than others or on specific days. Curators are encouraged to save your song increasing visibility over time.
Simply placing your song on high-stream playlists wont build a loyal audience. I cant guarantee streams; my service focuses on gradual listener & follower growth not bot-driven spikes.
My goal is to expose your music to new listeners.

What is the difference?
A floor plan is a 2D plan or drawing that shows a two-dimensional view of a project such as an architectural layout or an interior design. It only includes height and width without depth. 2D plans are useful for showing the arrangement of spaces the placement of elements and exact measurements. They are essential for planning and construction.
While 2D plans are precise in terms of dimensions and layout they dont depict how the space or design will look.
A render is a computer-generated image that simulates how the project will look in reality taking into account lighting textures and materials.
It provides a three-dimensional representation of how the project will appear. Are useful for visualizing the final look of the project allowing you to see details like material finishes colors and the overall atmosphere. This helps in making decisions and adjustments before construction or implementation.
